selection.variant: Original OpenRacer 5-inch frame: 2.5 mm bottom plate, 2.5 mm top (Mid) plate, four 5 mm 'Fatty' 4-hole arms, AnalogSmoothClassic TPU canopy
rationale: README: 'Carbon files are for 5 inch props unless otherwise specified'; recommended thickness Top/Bottom 2.5 mm, Arms 5 mm
Fatty arms are the arm style the README recommends; the Fatty DXF is drawn in frame coordinates and its root hole lands on the plate corner hole (22, -22)
AnalogSmoothClassic canopy: README says the Classic canopies fit normal 20x20 and 30x30 stacks; its four legs centre on the plate holes (+-22, +-22); no camera locker needed; 59k source triangles
JM Light (2 mm plates, STEP only) and 4/5.5/6-inch XV arms excluded: different plate thickness or prop size; nothing is mixed across variants

excluded_optional.cad/Carbon/Braces/4mm_Brace.dxf: optional front/rear braces; absent from the repository photographs and JM Light lists them as optional; vertical position not documented, so not placed
excluded_optional.camera lockers, fins, GoPro mounts, TPU: accessories, not part of the bare frame

inventory_cad_formats.cad/Carbon: 16 DXF (2D outlines, mm), 3 STEP (JM Light only)
inventory_cad_formats.canopy folders (AnalogPro, AnalogSharpCl: STL (Y-up, mm); SharkCanopies also one F3D

conversion.determinism: two consecutive runs produced byte-identical GLBs (same SHA-256)

tools.blender: 5.2.2 LTS (hash d13f752e3b9c, built 2026-09-15), Windows x64, blender.exe sha256 f141a3c5754500e6f84361099a4cd53f0bb7662b6a0d2cfaaa8fbb63e92234a0
tools.dxf_reader: built into build_fpv5_glb.py (LINE, ARC incl. OCS extrusion -Z, CIRCLE, LWPOLYLINE with bulge); Blender 5.2 ships no DXF importer
tools.step_converter: not needed and not used; no FreeCAD/gmsh/OCP found on this machine

conversion.units: DXF $INSUNITS=4 (mm) and STL mm, scaled by 0.001 to metres
conversion.dxf_tessellation: arcs and circles at 0.03 mm chord sagitta; concentric countersink circles on the bottom plate reduced to the through-hole radius (8 circles dropped)

assembly.arms: the one arm DXF is placed four times by 0/90/180/270 deg rotation about the plate centre (identical cut parts), not mirrored
assembly.stack_source: README hardware list: arm screws pass bottom plate, arm and top plate (pressnut); canopy legs sit on the top plate (photo_AnalogSharpClassic_with_camlocker.jpg)

axis_transform.dxf_to_blender: (x, y) -> (x, y, z_stack); DXF +Y is the nose (canopy overhang and camera bay at +Y)
axis_transform.stl_to_blender: (x, y, z) -> (x, -z, y + 2.5 mm); STL is Y-up with the camera bay at -Z
axis_transform.result: glTF/Godot +Y up, nose -Z, right +X (matches app/render/frames.gd render axes: x east/right, y up, z = -forward); verified in Godot: canopy AABB z from -0.04069 (nose) to +0.03348

conversion.origin: geometric centre of the four motor-mount centres (centre hole of each arm's 4-hole pattern), in the motor-mount plane (top face of the arms)

materials.carbon_fibre: Principled BSDF, base colour (0.025, 0.025, 0.028), metallic 0, roughness 0.35; plates and arms
materials.printed_tpu: Principled BSDF, base colour (0.80, 0.12, 0.06), metallic 0, roughness 0.65; canopy
materials.metal: no metal parts exist in the selected download (screws, standoffs, motors absent)

conversion.normals: smooth shading with sharp edges above 30 deg; exporter splits vertices there
conversion.nodes: airframe_root (root) > frame_carbon, canopy (meshes), motor_1..4, propeller_1..4, camera_mount (empties); no cameras, lights or animation

assembly_mapping.propeller_nodes: placed at the motor-mount centres in the mount plane; real prop height depends on the missing motors
assembly_mapping.spin_directions: not encoded in the asset; spin is explicit data in the multirotor configuration
assembly_mapping.camera_mount: centre of the coaxial camera side-screw holes of the canopy camera bay (pivot axis), x = 0; side hole area 2.81 mm2 (about M2), one hole pair found. The lens is forward of this pivot by a camera-dependent offset; no camera is in the download

measured_geometry_mm.layout: true (square) X: all four adjacent spacings equal to 0.001 mm, front/back minus left/right = 0.0 mm; arms on the 45 deg diagonals; hub coordinates differ by 0.013 mm from perfect diagonals as drawn in the arm DXF
measured_geometry_mm.motor_mount_pattern: 4 x M3 (r 1.5) on a 16 mm circle (holes 8 mm from centre) around a 6 mm centre hole

prop_clearance.method: coplanar circular prop discs centred on the hubs. Canopy margin = plan-view distance from hub to the nearest canopy vertex (source mesh, before decimation) minus prop radius; that canopy point is 15.5 mm above the mount plane, so the real 3D margin depends on the missing motor height and prop pitch/flex

versus_physics_assumption.difference: diagonal 9.68 mm (4.5 %) shorter; hub radius 102.66 vs 107.50 mm; adjacent spacing 145.19 vs 152.03 mm; layout type agrees (true X)

missing_parts: propellers (4); 5.0 vs 5.1 inch choice not fixed by the frame
flight controller, ESC, receiver, VTX, antenna, wiring
FPV camera (canopy has only the camera bay)
standoffs (4 x 10 mm M3), screws, pressnuts
not_established: mass, CG and inertia (geometry does not give material mass)

facts: The pinned repository's root LICENSE is the GPL version 3 text (blob f288702d2fa16d3cdf0035b15a9fcbc552cd88e7), added in 2023 by commit ea0af01c3d; no file-specific licence notices exist
The GLB is a modified work derived from four GPL-3.0 source files: 2D outlines extruded, parts assembled, canopy decimated, materials and empties added

The repository carries a notice (app/assets/multirotors/openrc-fpv5/NOTICE.md) naming the source, licence, commit, hashes and modifications, and carries the conversion script that regenerates the GLB from the unmodified source files
The full GPL-3.0 licence text is not yet copied into this repository; NOTICE.md links the pinned LICENSE file
The simulator's own code licence (MIT) is not applied to this asset
redistribution.decision: not made by this intake; the project owner decides how to distribute the GLB and whether to bundle the licence text and the unmodified source files
